checks.title: A/A gap between a harness and its own copy, largest cell
checks.meaning: The largest gap between a harness and its identical copy, and the cell where it happened.

checks.title: A/A noise floor, worst scored cell
checks.meaning: The same floor in the noisiest cell. Comparisons in that cell resolve only larger differences.

checks.title: Measured values flagged by the MAD rule

checks.title: Calibration: CV of the reference's CPU time between identical runs
checks.meaning: How much the reference's CPU time varied between identical calibration runs. Lower means a quieter host.

checks.title: A/A CV of CPU metrics, median over arms and cells
checks.meaning: How much CPU time varies from round to round for one harness. Lower means a quieter host.

checks.title: A/A pairs with a significant gap (paired p < 0.05, before Holm) that is also larger than 1%
checks.meaning: Share of harness and copy pairs that differ by more than 1% and also pass a significance test. A gap under 1% on a steady counter is not counted. About 5% can happen by chance.

checks.title: A/A gap between a harness and its own copy, median over cells
checks.meaning: The usual gap between a harness and its identical copy. A real difference between two harnesses should be larger than this.

checks.title: A/A noise floor, median over scored cells
checks.meaning: The smallest difference the identical copies cannot tell from noise, in the usual cell. Smaller differences than this are not resolved.

checks.title: Measured samples with at least one host flag
checks.meaning: Share of samples where the host showed a disturbance: throttling, foreign CPU, steal, a clock change, swap or a memory event.

checks.title: Measured samples with CFS throttling (arm cgroup, every ancestor, session)
checks.meaning: Samples where the kernel held the process back for a CPU quota. Their time then describes the quota, not the harness.

checks.title: Steal: share of the pinned CPUs' capacity taken by a hypervisor
checks.meaning: Share of the pinned CPUs' time that a hypervisor took away. It only matters on virtual machines.

checks.title: Foreign CPU on the pinned CPUs during a sample, p95 over samples, as a share of the sample's CPU time
checks.meaning: CPU time that other processes used on the pinned cores during a sample, as a share of the sample's own CPU time (95th percentile).

checks.title: Samples that waited more than 1 s for the host to quiet down
checks.meaning: Share of samples that had to wait for the quiet-host gate. A busy host makes the gate wait.

checks.title: Samples for which the host never quieted down
checks.meaning: Samples that did not start because the host stayed busy. They are not in the numbers.

checks.title: Effective clock: largest deviation of a sample's mean MHz from the run median
checks.meaning: How far a sample's mean CPU clock moved from the run median. A moving clock changes CPU time for the same work.

checks.title: Infrastructure failures (envelope OOM, no process started, runner fault) over measured samples
checks.meaning: Share of samples that failed because of the host or the runner. They are never charged to a harness.

checks.title: Arm failures over measured samples (a swarm ladder's designed stops are results and not counted)
checks.meaning: Share of samples where the harness itself failed. A scale sample that stopped because the kernel's limit was reached (stop_cause oom, pids or timeout) is a result and is in neither the failures nor the samples counted; a scale error stop is a failure.

checks.title: Drift: median absolute change over the run of an arm's value, over cells
checks.meaning: How much a harness's value moved from the start of the run to the end. Drift means the host changed during the run.

checks.title: No change point in the reference arm's per-round series
checks.meaning: The host's speed did not shift during the run. A shift moves every comparison the same way.

checks.title: At least 12 measured rounds
checks.meaning: With fewer rounds the intervals are wide.

checks.title: Every arm has an A/A copy
checks.meaning: Without a copy there is no noise floor for that harness.

checks.title: No harness connected outside the loopback
checks.meaning: A harness that talks to the network is not measured alone.

checks.title: Every executable and install tree unchanged during the run
checks.meaning: A changed executable means the arm is not what the lock names.
checks.detail: every executable and install tree unchanged

checks.title: Calibration ran and the reference stayed within its 5% limit
checks.meaning: Calibration shows the host's noise before the run. Above 5% the run is labelled Noisy.

checks.title: Telemetry recorded for every measured sample
checks.meaning: Telemetry is how the other checks see the host.

checks.title: No CPU quota (cpu.max) on the arm cgroup or any ancestor
checks.meaning: A quota can throttle a sample.
checks.detail: no ancestor of the arm cgroup has a CPU quota

checks.title: The pinned CPUs have a fixed clock policy
checks.meaning: A clock that scales with load changes CPU time for the same work.
checks.detail: the pinned CPUs have a fixed clock policy (or the machine does not say)
